title: Channels, Memberships, Access, Telegram, And Briefing Full React Parity

specify.notes: Created Spec 045 from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers React-only memberships/access, Telegram/channel delivery, and briefing preferences while preserving retained JSON APIs and deleting only bounded domain templates after parity evidence.

auto_clarifications: Include all admin browser pages for access and people workflows.
Show link tokens only immediately after creation.
Preserve old direct links through authenticated React redirects.
Keep tenant-user and tenant-admin views separated by backend policy.
Keep destructive membership confirmations and revision checks backend-owned.
Use mocked-safe Telegram webhook validation with no full identifiers.
Include briefing import/export browser routes and safe artifact metadata.
Retain API-only routes used by React.

plan.notes: Planned React-only browser parity for memberships/access, Telegram/channel delivery, and briefing preferences by retaining JSON APIs, converting old browser routes to React redirects or safe compatibility handlers, deleting only bounded domain templates, and validating with backend/frontend/QA/Playwright gates.

tasks.notes: Generated dependency-ordered tasks covering legacy route tests, membership/Telegram/briefing redirects, form-post compatibility, template deletion, docs, TypeScript generation, backend/frontend validation, QA docs, Spec QA, and Playwright evidence.

remediations: Identified old Telegram link-token form posts as a special non-Jinja compatibility path: return immediate JSON with the one-time token instead of redirecting and losing the token.
analyze.notes: Read-only analysis confirmed the remaining deletable domain templates are memberships/index.html, telegram/index.html, and briefing_preferences/index.html. Admin shell Jinja remains for Spec 047. Existing React membership and channel workspaces already provide replacement routes and retained JSON APIs.

implement.notes: Converted legacy memberships, Telegram/channel, and briefing browser routes to React redirects or safe non-Jinja compatibility handlers, updated admin navigation/filter destinations, deleted bounded domain templates, added retirement scanners and redirected-route coverage, and created required QA artifacts.
